| infl.      | class       | meaning |

### Etymology
#### Glyph
口 + the curve represents a tongue inside
#### Sound
- Japanese onomatopoeia "hamuhamu"
- *imitative of:* eating something
- *a priori:* h=emptiness/hunger, an=bodily
